'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=二契}} is a quest-exclusive NPC who first appeared during the {{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}}.

==Profile==
Second Seal was one of the Seals of Ten Seals Covenant, a group founded by [[Suoming]] to combat the Evil Miasma in her hometown, [[Huating]], where all of its members, besides Suoming, have since fallen. Suoming sealed Second's frequency alongside the other Seals and the Evil Miasma.
